candidate_windows.window_text:
We seek to understand the impact of model interventions on the representational space of mLLMs with a focus on cross-lingual alignment. We consider three open-source mLLMs: Aya-8b (instruction fine-tuned) (Aryabumi et al., 2024), PolyLM-13b (chat version) (Wei et al., 2023), and Bloom-7b (base) (Scao et al., 2022). Since our aim is to draw conclusions about cross-lingual alignment, we want to make sure that we know what languages

were seen in pre-training and include mLLMs for which a detailed description of pre-training datasets is available, excluding LLMs such as Mistral (Jiang et al., 2023), Llama (Touvron et al., 2023), and Gemma (Team et al., 2024). We begin by identifying and intervening on the language experts in the mLLMs and then study cross-lingual alignment in the embedding space and downstream task performance pre- and post-intervention.
All experiments were run on 8 A100(80GB) GPUs. The total approximate running time for 90 GPU/hours Aya-8B, 120 GPU/hours for PolyLM-13B, and 110 GPU/hours for Bloom-7B.
